# How Does a Designer Develop Recognizable Codes? — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-159187
Voiceover: The record separates the material dress, House of Worth attribution, Charles Frederick Worth design credit, accession, and the museum’s present custody.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Brooklyn Museum Costume Collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Gift of the Brooklyn Museum, 2009; Gift of the Princess Viggo in accordance with the wishes of the Misses Hewitt, 1931

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — B02-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · NOTICE — What actually recurs?. Sample complete bodies of work, not isolated hero images. Code observable decisions—proportion, line, volume, material, construction, color, finish, movement, casting, image, language, refusal—and keep fact separate from critical interpretation.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — B02-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · NAME — Can the decision be described without mystique?. Write each code as a decision with range and rationale: what changes, what stays, what problem it solves, who contributes, and which exception proves that the principle is alive rather than decorative repetition.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — B02-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · TEST — Can another person recognize and challenge it?. Use blind comparisons, counterexamples, fittings, material trials, and collaborator critique. Record disagreement. If recognition depends entirely on founder explanation, the code has not yet become shared institutional knowledge.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — B02-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · BOUND — What is cultural signal, and what is a legal asset?. Separate reputation and visual resemblance from exact copyrighted expression, registered marks, design rights, contracts, confidential information, and other evidence. A codebook supports practice; it does not create a monopoly over style.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
